name: Bens Email Marketing & Automation
author: Wpbens

sections.description:
Email Marketing & Automation for WordPress is a powerful all-in-one solution designed to help you grow your audience, send beautiful email campaigns, and automate your marketing — directly from your WordPress dashboard.

🚀 Features

  • Email Campaign Builder – Create beautiful emails using a drag-and-drop builder or HTML editor.
  • Marketing Automation – Send emails based on user behavior, custom events, or scheduled triggers.
  • Subscriber Management – Add, segment, and manage your contact lists with ease.
  • Analytics & Reports – Track opens, clicks, bounces, and more with real-time insights.

🛠 Installation

  1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Dashboard → Plugins → Add New.
  3. Click “Upload Plugin” and select the downloaded zip file.
  4. Click “Install Now”, then “Activate”.

✅ Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce (optional, for eCommerce email automation)

📚 Usage

After activation:

  1. Go to Email Marketing in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Configure your sender email and SMTP settings.
  3. Start by creating a subscriber form or importing your list.
  4. Create your first email campaign or set up automation flows.
  5. Monitor campaign performance from the Reports section.

🔌 Integrations

  • WooCommerce
  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor
  • Mailchimp (optional import/export)
  • Zapier Webhooks (Pro version)

💼 Use Cases

  • Welcome email sequences
  • Abandoned cart recovery
  • Newsletter campaigns
  • Event reminders
  • Drip email courses
  • Customer re-engagement flows

🧩 Shortcodes

Use these shortcodes in pages, posts, or widgets:

  • [email_signup_form] – Display a subscription form
  • [subscriber_count] – Show total subscribers
  • [email_unsubscribe] – Add an unsubscribe link

🆘 Support

Need help? Visit the Support Forum or check the plugin’s Documentation for guides and FAQs.

📦 Pro Version

Unlock advanced features with the Pro version:

  • Advanced segmentation
  • Conditional automation flows
  • A/B testing
  • Email scheduling
  • Priority support

👉 Upgrade to Pro

🔒 Privacy & Security

This plugin does not send data to third-party services by default. All subscriber data is stored securely within your WordPress site unless integrated with external services (e.g., SMTP).

🙌 Contributing

Pull requests are welcome. Please fork the repo and submit your contributions.
